notes: storm_surge: reported once, never per site — the SSA layers in this archive are national-resolution and simplified low-zoom rings overlap inland Quezon City; per spec §3 storm surge is excluded from the exposure feature (landlocked QC), so every site carries storm_surge: null.

this archive carries national NOAH extent (millions of polygon features spanning the Philippines), despite the repo note saying clipped-to-QC; band sampling is point-in-polygon against the real geometry so values remain geodetically exact, and sampling stays independent of the archive's clip claims.

sampling.nullSemantics: band null = layer never shipped data near the site; band 0 = map data exists there and contains no hazard polygon at that point
sampling.zoomStrategy: each sample evaluated once, at the finest zoom whose tile contains it and carries the layer; lower zooms are never mixed (their simplified rings can swallow neighbouring inland areas)
